message: The other night, I decided to do a little fire safety check while making dinner. As I climbed up to test the smoke alarms, I thought about how I used to dread these little tasks. But instead of it feeling like a chore, I turned it into a cozy event—cranked up some music, made a game of it, and even rewarded myself with a slice of my favorite pie afterward. It’s amazing how a tiny shift in perspective can make even safety checks feel more fun! How do you turn your prep tasks into something enjoyable?
